Burn Test Log

Wick choice is found by testing, not by calculation. Your wax, your fragrance load, your dye and the width of your jar all change which wick is right — so the only way to know is to burn one and watch it.

What to watch for. A full melt pool reaching the edge of the jar within about 3 to 4 hours, a flame that stays steady rather than flickering or dancing, no soot on the glass, and no mushrooming on the wick tip. Too small and it tunnels. Too big and it smokes and overheats the jar. Test at least two of every wick size so you can repeat a result.
